# ComfyUI SSStereoscope

> Transform any 2D image into immersive stereoscopic 3D content within ComfyUI. Powered by Depth-Anything V2 &amp; V3, featuring HighSodium optimization, and full video support for VR headsets.

## Project Details
- **Author:** SamSeen (SamSeenX)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/SamSeenX/ComfyUI_SSStereoscope
- **Category:** Multimedia Application, AI, 3D
- **Operating System:** Any (Runs inside ComfyUI)

## How It Works
1. **Input:** Feeds an AI-generated art, photograph, or video frame into the SBS V2 Node.
2. **Processing:** The node calculates the offset for the left and right eyes based on a dynamic `depth_scale`.
3. **Output:** A Side-by-Side (SBS) image or video ready to be viewed on VR headsets, 3D displays, or using the cross-eye technique.

## Key Features
- **AI-Powered Depth:** Utilizes state-of-the-art Depth-Anything (V2 & V3) models for depth estimation.
- **HighSodium Optimization:** A vectorized algorithm ensuring up to 4x faster rendering speeds for bulk tasks.
- **Full Video Pipeline:** Turn flat MP4s into spatial videos with dedicated node setups.
- **Granular Control:** Adjust depth scale, blur radius, and easily switch between Parallel or Cross-eyed modes.
- **External Depth Maps:** Feed custom depth data into the V2.1 fast generator.
